other_conditions: Must be a farmer of Chhattisgarh who cultivated paddy in the Kharif season of 2020 and sold the harvested paddy to the government.
Must be a forest rights holder who sold paddy to the government in the previous year and wishes to replace paddy cultivation with tree planting on the same land.
Must be a forest rights holder who wants to start tree plantation on their land for the first time.
Must be a Gram Panchayat or Joint Forest Management Committee that intends to plant trees on revenue land using the funds available to them.
Mandatory registration is required; unregistered farmers are not eligible for incentives.
benefits_summary: Participants receive Rs 10,000 per acre per year as an incentive for successful tree plantation (three years for farmers, one year for Gram Panchayats and Joint Forest Management Committees).
